name: schoolname-get-terms
description:
Gets the terms for given Start/End date ranges in YYYY-MM-DD format. 

If no dates are provided, uses one year before today and after today

parameters.name: startsOnOrBeforeDate
parameters.label: Starts On or Before Date
parameters.description:
The Date which the term(s) will start on or before. Often this today through a future date.

Will default to 365 days in the future.

parameters.name: endsOnOrAfterDate
parameters.label: Ends On or After Date
parameters.description:
The Date which the term(s) will end on or after. Often this a past date through today. 

Will default to 365 days ago.

parameters.name: calculationDate
parameters.label: Term Calculation Date
parameters.description:
The date all the buckets of Terms will calculate as "Today". This is used to determine is in the past, current, and future.

Will default to Today.
